rationale: The workflow runs on a daily schedule to check for external dependency updates (webtrees versions) and create issues. The most relevant pattern, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (suppress schedules during repository inactivity), has a contraindication for 'External dependencies, security or time-based requirements need fresh checks' which directly applies here since the workflow's purpose is to detect external version changes. Other patterns (caching, matrix fail-fast, stale cancellation, path filtering, timeouts, test prioritization) are not applicable to this single-job scheduled workflow that completes in ~8 seconds with no heavy dependencies, matrix, or test suite. The CI history shows consistent successful runs with no failures to justify P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE. No evidence-supported optimization preserves the intended external-update-checking behavior.
